scope: Orléans 2014 dlp base game, 2–4 players; English booklet pp.12–21, base Place Tiles pp.22–23, components p.24. Excludes optional Place Tile exclusion and expansions.

grading_standard.correct: Every requested material fact correct and supported; no contradictory/unresolved ruling.
grading_standard.partial: At least one missing/unresolved requested fact, no material contradiction.
grading_standard.incorrect: At least one material source contradiction.
grading_standard.support: Unsupported correct guesses flagged separately and do not satisfy completion.

answers.expected_answer: No one gains for a tied lead; the unique last player pays 1 coin. With 2 players, unique leader gains 1 coin and last pays nothing.
Drawing is optional up to the Knight allowance and free Market capacity; draw at most two. Unused Market Followers remain and occupy spaces.
answers.novelty: Draw allowance versus capacity and retention

answers.expected_answer: May fill over rounds, cannot execute until all required spaces occupied. May save activation with tiles left in place. On execution Followers go to own bag; Technology stays.

Start player then clockwise, one action or pass per turn, repeat until all pass. Passing ends own actions this round even if activated actions remain; unused activation and Followers stay for a later round.
answers.novelty: Action turn cycle and irreversible pass

answers.expected_answer: Take Farmer into own bag; advance Farmer track one space and take depicted good.

Choose Boatman, Craftsman or Trader, put recruit in bag and advance corresponding track. Boatman gains depicted coins (first at last space gets Citizen instead); Craftsman gains Technology usable only after passing; Trader gains Place Tile.

Only use after passing, so no further own action this round. First must replace Farmer; later any required Character except Monk. Max one per Place, no single-Character Places, cannot move after placement; remains until game end.
First advance category I only; later I or II. Place beside board; can activate/use ability; stacks inspectable at any time.

University Scholar into bag, advance Scholars and gain depicted Development Points; Castle Knight into bag, advance Knights for draw limit; fourth Knight stays draw 7, first there may take Citizen. Monastery Monk into bag, no additional bonus. At final track space cannot take corresponding action again.
answers.novelty: Other recruitment and final track boundaries

answers.expected_answer: Monk may replace Knight or any other Character in ordinary actions. No other Character or Technology can replace required Monk. Beneficial Deeds require exact depicted types, no Monk substitution.
Ship moves to one adjacent town along Waterway; Wagon likewise along Road. May take one good from connection even if multiple; keep by board. Empty links legal, give no good.
Build Trading Station in Merchant current town; no existing station of any player allowed. In Orléans each player may build one.

Scriptorium gives 1 Development Point/advance 1 space. Landing/passing coin gives depicted coins; first landing/passing Citizen gets it. Landing/passing status immediately sets Development Status to shown value (initially 1).

One or two can activate, move one or both to free matching Deed spaces; colored starters prohibited. Receive depicted 1/2/3 coins per tile; Canalization 1 coin or 1 Development Point. Tile remains permanently. Completing last vacant Deed space earns its Citizen.
answers.novelty: Town Hall routing, rewards and completion

answers.expected_answer: Pilgrimage forbids recruiting Monks during Phase 5 Actions. Other events resolve Phase 6. Pilgrimage is deliberately first/top tile.
Grain/cheese/wine qualify, wool does not. Must pay one food to Goods Market; if no food pay 5 coins, if unable undergo torture for missing coins.
Neutral Scholar returned to game board, available again; do not move Scholar track backward. Colored starter cannot be lost; keep it and lose no tile this round, no redraw.

Pay available coin and replace each missing coin (two) with one item, any mix: built/supply Trading Station, random bag Follower (redraw colored starters), Development Point (left one, never onto/past coin space), Goods, Place, Technology. Remove items from game, only Development Points can be regained.
Tiles limited: cannot play action providing unavailable tile. Harvest/Plague can return stock, permitting actions again. With insufficient supply coins, players cannot receive coins at that moment.

Tied most stations gives no bonus Citizen. Grain 1, cheese 2, wine 3, wool 4, brocade 5; coins 1 VP each; (built stations + collected Citizens) × Development Status. Highest VP; tie furthest ahead on Development Track; still tied share win.
answers.novelty: End bonus, complete scoring and tiebreak
